annotations.title: Verify a claim against a stored passage

description: Score whether a stored index passage supports a claim. Pass id from a search cite, or source plus doc. Loads the stored excerpt then returns noul 0-1, skipped if the judge is unavailable, or no_passage if the index has no excerpt. Not a live web fetch. The judge is not a source.

claim.description: Claim to score against the stored excerpt.

doc.description: Document id when id is omitted (with source).

id.description: Vectorize id from a search cite.

source.description: Corpus source when id is omitted (with doc).

name: verify_claim
